actual_rule_observed: A page with eleventyNavigation.key but no order sorts AFTER every page that has an explicit order value; a missing order does not behave like the documented default of 0.
notes: Docs say "If omitted, `order: 0` is the default," which predicts index 0 (before Home, order 1); the page landed at index 4 instead. Also observed: the rendered link text was the key "ProbeOne", not the page frontmatter title "Probe One Page" — the starter template renders entry.title, which falls back to entry.key when eleventyNavigation.title is absent; a page-level `title` in frontmatter is not used for the nav label. Page deleted after probe to restore baseline.
